prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create the Payday edition of the existing promotional banner layout.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY ARTWORK REFERENCE and replaces the previous pink-haired character: use its long straight black-haired adult anime woman with blunt bangs, pale lavender eyes, relaxed tilted-head pose, grey zip hoodie over a dark top, black collar and simple necklace. Preserve her likeness, clothing, calm expression, clean anime linework and light/shadow style. Keep her fully clothed, waist-up, large and sharp.
Image 2 is only a reference for the wide banner layout and bold promotional typography. Do not use its pink-haired woman or its Weekly Cashback copy.
Output: a finished 1882 x 836 wide Payday banner. Single black-haired woman from image 1 occupies the right half, face clear and unobstructed. The background is one continuous weathered concrete graffiti wall inspired by image 1, charcoal/navy and grey with mint, cyan and restrained lime/yellow paint accents, wall seams, drips and layered abstract spray-painted shapes. Preserve visual depth while keeping the character crisp. Darker painted wall behind the left copy, naturally integrated rather than a separate panel. Maintain at least 60px safe margin for all text.
Exact readable copy only:
"PAYDAY" as the large bold condensed italic white headline at upper-left.
"UP TO" in smaller white uppercase immediately above the amount.
"₱5,000" as the dominant large ONE-LINE ivory-white amount below, with deep charcoal/navy outline and a restrained cyan/mint offset paint-stroke shadow. Include the Philippine peso sign and comma exactly. Fit the entire amount within the left 46% without covering the character; use condensed numerals as needed.
No other readable copy, no WEEKLY/CASHBACK, no percentages, dates, subtitles, buttons, coins, logos, rooster or watermarks. Only one character. Keep bottom-right corner free of essential detail for carousel dots. Premium contemporary anime street-art advertising, coherent sharp facial features and hands, no muddy image texture, no excessive neon glow, no metallic 3D lettering.
note: The black-haired character reference supersedes the earlier request to reuse the Weekly Cashback pink-haired artwork.
